# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

**Top pick for most people: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro**
- It lists at $149.99. Dealectric says code AFSC20 brings it to about $120 (tested in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, expires 2026-12-31, and doesn't work on items already on sale).
- It has adaptive ANC, LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5 water resistance. [SoundGuys' score, via iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), was 8.2/10, and iTech Level notes it's often discounted to around $100.
- Downsides: the touchscreen case is a gimmick, and spatial audio is weak. Its measured battery was about 5h 42m with ANC on.
- [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro)
- Source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150-2026-reviews-prices)

**Other good options**
- **Nothing Ear (3):** Best ANC in this price range, per iTech Level. SoundGuys scored its ANC 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging, and costs just under $150 on Amazon. The sound is bass-heavy and call mics are muffled. [See it here](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)
- **Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro (~$134 on Amazon):** Great adaptive ANC and IPX7. It works on most Android phones but is aimed at Samsung users. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- **Sony WF-C710N (~$119 at Walmart):** What Hi-Fi? names it its best budget pick. [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)
- **AirPods Pro 2 (renewed, just under $150 on sale):** Excellent ANC for iPhone users, but Apple no longer sells them new. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- **Soundcore P31i ($59.99):** Adaptive ANC, 50 hours of total battery and IP55, if you want to spend much less. Its ANC isn't top-tier. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Skip for this purpose:** The soundcore AeroFit 2 is open-ear with no ANC. The AirPods 5 ($129, or $149 with wireless charging) also have an open fit, which blocks less noise than sealed buds. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))

**Worth knowing**
- The search results only gave a direct purchase link for the Liberty 4 Pro. The other links go to review pages that have retailer buttons, and prices there may have changed.
- If you can stretch the budget, RTINGS' top picks are the Sony WF-1000XM6 and Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro ($169.99). Both are over $150. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds))

Tell me whether you use an iPhone or Android and I can narrow it to one pick.
